sender.en: “Pošta Srbije”, “Post Express” or a foreign number

name.sr: Lažni SMS Pošte Srbije: pošiljka zadržana, potvrdite adresu ili platite carinu
name.en: Fake Pošta Srbije text: parcel held, confirm your address or pay customs

how.sr: Stiže SMS da je paket u magacinu i ne može da se isporuči jer adresa nije potpuna, ili da je zadržan dok ne platite malu carinu ili troškove. Link vodi na lažnu stranicu sa logom Pošte, gde unosite adresu i podatke kartice. Sa kartice zatim skidaju novac. Pošta Srbije ne traži unos podataka ni plaćanje preko linka.
how.en: A text says a parcel is in the warehouse and can’t be delivered because the address is incomplete, or that it’s held until you pay a small customs or handling fee. The link opens a fake page with the Post logo where you enter your address and card details. Money is then taken from the card. Pošta Srbije never asks for data or payment through a link.

text.sr: Poruka u ime Pošte Srbije o zadržanoj pošiljci.
text.en: A message in the name of Pošta Srbije about a held parcel.

text.sr: Link ka stranici koja nije posta.rs.
text.en: A link to a page that isn’t posta.rs.

text.sr: Mali iznos za carinu ili ponovnu dostavu, karticom.
text.en: A small fee for customs or redelivery, by card.
A deadline: the parcel goes back to the sender.

text.sr: Posta Srbije: Vasa posiljka je stigla u nas magacin, ali ne moze biti isporucena zbog nepotpune adrese. Azurirajte podatke u roku od 24h kako bi posiljka bila isporucena: [link]
text.en: Posta Srbije: Your parcel has reached our warehouse but cannot be delivered because the address is incomplete. Update your details within 24h so the parcel can be delivered: [link]

sr: Pošta Srbije ne traži unos ličnih podataka ni plaćanje preko linka.
Link koji nije na adresi posta.rs.
Loš jezik, bez kvačica, i nepotpuni podaci o firmi.
Niste ništa naručili ili ne čekate pošiljku.
en: Pošta Srbije doesn’t ask for personal data or payment through a link.
A link that isn’t on posta.rs.
Poor language, no diacritics and incomplete company details.
You haven’t ordered anything or aren’t expecting a parcel.

sr: Ne otvarajte link. Pošiljku proverite na posta.rs ili u kontakt centru Pošte.
Ako ste uneli karticu, odmah je blokirajte u banci.
Poruku prijavite CERT-u ili na Sajber straži, pa je obrišite.
en: Don’t open the link. Check the parcel on posta.rs or with the Post contact centre.
If you entered your card, block it with your bank at once.
Report the message to CERT or on Sajber straža, then delete it.
